backup.production_rule: Adds public.stay_phase_v1 (upcoming / inside / departed by the clock: the stay's own times, else app_settings house_times, else 14:00 in / 12:00 out) and public.staff_current_next_stays_at_v1 (fixed clock). staff_current_next_stays_v1 now calls the latter with Manila now(); get_admin_overview_v1 changes one where-clause (currentStays). Return shapes and grants are unchanged. It stops (55000) unless both live bodies are the 2026-11-29 ones or these. No table, column or row changes.
backup.notes: restore_point and verified_at are placeholders: restamp them with a fresh backup at apply time (scripts/migrations/fill-restore-point.mjs). Independent of record_offline_booking_20261211 and void_cancels_confirmed_calendar_20261212 (touches none of their functions); apply after them so the CLI order stays ascending.

forward_verification.name: stays_body_is_the_new_one
forward_verification.query: select md5(replace(prosrc, chr(13), '')) = 'acb8d787e00683d629fbc2c47e12f8ba' from pg_proc where oid = 'public.staff_current_next_stays_v1(uuid)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: admin_overview_body_is_the_new_one
forward_verification.query: select md5(replace(prosrc, chr(13), '')) = '382132f2b8fc01ac4a3dbf3f79b11ae4' from pg_proc where oid = 'public.get_admin_overview_v1(uuid)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: new_functions_are_closed_to_clients
forward_verification.query: select not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.stay_phase_v1(date, date, time, time, timestamp)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.stay_phase_v1(date, date, time, time, timestamp)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.stay_phase_v1(date, date, time, time, timestamp)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.staff_current_next_stays_at_v1(uuid, timestamp)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.staff_current_next_stays_at_v1(uuid, timestamp)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.staff_current_next_stays_at_v1(uuid, timestamp)', 'execute')

forward_verification.name: existing_grants_unchanged
forward_verification.query: select has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.staff_current_next_stays_v1(uuid)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.staff_current_next_stays_v1(uuid)', 'execute') and has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.get_admin_overview_v1(uuid)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.get_admin_overview_v1(uuid)', 'execute')

forward_verification.name: definer_chain_shares_one_owner
forward_verification.query: select count(distinct proowner) = 1 from pg_proc where oid in ('public.stay_phase_v1(date, date, time, time, timestamp)'::regprocedure, 'public.staff_current_next_stays_at_v1(uuid, timestamp)'::regprocedure, 'public.staff_current_next_stays_v1(uuid)'::regprocedure, 'public.get_admin_overview_v1(uuid)'::regprocedure, 'public.staff_home_v1(uuid)'::regprocedure)

rollback.safe_until: any time; it restores both previous bodies and drops the two new functions

feature_flags.name: no_flag_read_models_only
feature_flags.required_state: None. Callers (staff_home_v1 -> Cascade Staff Today card, admin dashboard overview) read the same shapes. The Today card already says 'arriving' when next checks in today and nobody is inside (lib.js todayCardState).

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the restore point is older than one hour, or restore_point / verified_at are still the placeholders
the migration guard raises 55000 (unknown live function body)
